response.sql: WITH status_metrics AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans, SUM(sc.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS gb_per_minute FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), status_average AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) AS avg_gb_per_minute FROM status_metrics) SELECT m.status, m.total_scans, m.gb_per_minute, m.gb_per_minute - a.avg_gb_per_minute AS exceeds_average_by FROM status_metrics AS m CROSS JOIN status_average AS a WHERE m.gb_per_minute > a.avg_gb_per_minute;
